title: PCB Mounting Bracket DFM Review – Rev A
content: Vendor recommends increasing bend radius on the mounting tabs from 0.5 mm to 0.8 mm to reduce crack risk in 1.5 mm CR steel. Corner notch relief holes of ∅3 mm should be added before each 90° bend. Minimum flange height revised to 8 mm to maintain punch clearance on the progressive die.

title: Power Supply Unit Electrical Specification
content: Input range: 85–264 V AC, 47–63 Hz. Output: 24 V DC ±2%, 10 A continuous. Efficiency ≥88% at full load per EN 62368-1. Ripple and noise not to exceed 50 mVpp measured with 20 MHz BW.

title: Sheet Metal Enclosure RFQ – Motor Drive
content: Request for quotation covering fabrication of ASM-008 sheet metal enclosure in 1.5 mm G90 galvanised steel. Quantity breaks at 50, 200, and 500 units required. Finish: RAL 7035 powder coat, minimum 60 µm DFT. Delivery 8 weeks ARO.

title: ECO-2025-112: Fastener Change M3 to M4 on Sensor Housing
content: Engineering Change Order replacing M3×8 pan head screws with M4×10 pan head screws on ASM-003 sensor housing cover. Change driven by field reports of thread stripping under repeated maintenance cycles. Updated torque specification: 1.8 N·m. Effective from serial number SN-2025-400 onward.

title: Connector Interface Board Tolerance Report
content: Worst-case tolerance stack-up analysis for D-sub connector alignment on ASM-012. Total accumulated tolerance ±0.45 mm against a nominal clearance of ±0.60 mm, leaving 0.15 mm margin. Analysis performed per ASME Y14.5-2018. No design change required.

title: Aluminium Heat Sink Vendor Feedback – Thermal Resistance
content: Vendor B reports measured thermal resistance of 0.85 °C/W for the specified extrusion profile, slightly above the 0.80 °C/W design target. Vendor proposes adding four 4 mm longitudinal fins to reduce resistance to 0.72 °C/W at a tooling cost of $1,200. Recommend accepting the modification.

title: RF Shield Assembly Dimensional Specification
content: Shield body dimensions: 85 mm × 60 mm × 12 mm (L×W×H). Wall thickness 0.5 mm ±0.05 mm. Lid engagement depth 2.0 mm minimum. Attenuation requirement: ≥40 dB from 100 MHz to 3 GHz per MIL-STD-285. Tin plating thickness: 5–8 µm over copper strike.

title: Battery Compartment DFM Review – Cover Seal
content: Moulding vendor recommends O-ring groove dimensions per AS568-013 standard, currently drawn as custom profile. Switching to standard AS568-013 groove eliminates custom tooling and reduces per-unit cost by approximately $0.15. Draft angle on cover interior should be increased from 0.5° to 1.5° to aid ejection.

title: Signal Conditioning Module Calibration Specification
content: All 4–20 mA channels shall be calibrated at 4 mA, 12 mA, and 20 mA reference points. Zero offset error ≤0.1% FSR. Span error ≤0.2% FSR. Calibration interval 24 months under normal operating conditions. Temperature coefficient of offset: ≤50 ppm/°C from –20 °C to +70 °C.

title: RFQ – Antenna Mount Bracket Fabrication
content: Quotation requested for CNC machining of ASM-010 antenna mount bracket from 6061-T6 aluminium billet. Surface finish Ra 1.6 µm on mating faces. Anodise to MIL-A-8625 Type II, clear. Annual volume estimate 1,000 units. Initial order 150 units, 6-week lead time required.

title: ECO-2025-089: Main Controller Board RTC Crystal Change
content: Replacing 32.768 kHz crystal Y1 with lower-ESR variant to resolve RTC startup failures at –30 °C. New part number: STD-042 (Epson FC-135R 32.768 kHz, ±20 ppm). Load capacitance adjusted from 12.5 pF to 7 pF by modifying C47 and C48 to 3.3 pF. PCB respun as Rev 3.1.

title: Cooling System Assembly Thermal Analysis
content: Thermal simulation of ASM-007 using boundary conditions: ambient 50 °C, 92 mm fan at 1,800 RPM. Junction temperature of IGBT module predicted at 112 °C against 150 °C maximum rating, giving 38 °C margin. Thermal interface material compressed to 0.15 mm at 30 psi contact pressure.

title: Front Control Panel Membrane Keypad Specification
content: Keypad actuation force: 250 ±50 gf. Travel: 0.4 mm. Minimum operational life: 1,000,000 cycles per key. Overlay material: 0.125 mm polyester with UV-stable inks. Rear adhesive: 3M 467MP, peel strength ≥2.5 N/mm. Operating temperature: –20 °C to +60 °C.

title: Vendor Feedback – Powder Coat Adhesion on Motor Drive Enclosure
content: Powder coat vendor flags insufficient surface preparation specification on DOC-003 drawing. Current spec calls for alkaline wash only; vendor recommends adding iron phosphate conversion coating step to achieve Class A adhesion per ASTM D3359. Cost impact approximately $0.80 per enclosure.

title: Tolerance Stack-Up: Sensor Module PCB to Enclosure
content: Six-part stack-up analysis for PCB standoff height and enclosure internal depth in ASM-003. Nominal air gap 3.0 mm, worst-case minimum 1.2 mm, worst-case maximum 4.8 mm. All cases within the 1.0 mm–5.0 mm design requirement. Statistical (RSS) analysis gives ±0.9 mm at 3σ.

title: RFQ – Signal Conditioning Module PCB Assembly
content: Request for quotation for PCB assembly of ASM-009 signal conditioning board, IPC Class 2. BOM includes 0402 passives, QFN-28 isolated DC-DC converter, and through-hole terminal blocks. Quote to include bare board procurement, SMT placement, wave solder, and AOI. Target price <$28/unit at 500 pieces.

title: ECO-2025-134: Battery Compartment Spring Contact Material Change
content: Spring contacts changed from phosphor bronze to beryllium copper to reduce contact resistance from 25 mΩ to 8 mΩ and improve fatigue life. Plating unchanged: 2.5 µm gold over 2.5 µm nickel. Supplier qualification required for BeCu contacts; two vendors approved: VND-003 and VND-005.

title: DFM Note – RF Shield Lid Retention Clip
content: Current lid design uses four formed clips requiring secondary press operation after plating. Vendor A recommends redesigning to integral spring fingers stamped from the lid body, eliminating the secondary operation and reducing assembly time by 45 seconds per unit. Tooling credit of $600 offered.

title: Connector Interface Board ESD Specification
content: All external signal lines on ASM-012 shall withstand ±15 kV contact discharge per IEC 61000-4-2 Level 4. TVS diode clamp voltage not to exceed 24 V at 1 A. Response time ≤1 ps. ESD protection components to be qualified to –40 °C to +85 °C storage range.

title: Vendor Feedback – Aluminium Extrusion Lead Time
content: Vendor B advises 14-week lead time for new aluminium extrusion die for ASM-007 heat sink profile due to die shop backlog. Standard stock extrusion 6063-T5 available in 4 weeks but does not meet the 250 W/m·K conductivity requirement. Recommend proceeding with custom extrusion and ordering safety stock of 200 units.

title: ECO-2025-099: Front Panel Display Upgrade
content: Replacing 2.4-inch TFT with IPS panel variant to improve viewing angle from ±45° to ±80° in response to field feedback. Backlight driver circuit unchanged. New display part number BRK-028 (replaces BRK-027). Updated firmware required: display init sequence change in display_driver.c line 142.

title: Material Specification – Enclosure Gasket
content: Gasket material shall be closed-cell silicone foam per MIL-C-6183, hardness 20–30 Shore A. Compression set ≤15% after 168 hours at 70 °C per ASTM D395 Method B. Adhesive backing 3M 9448A. Operating temperature range –55 °C to +125 °C. Thickness 3.0 mm ±0.3 mm, compressed to 2.0 mm at assembly.

title: Tolerance Report – Cooling Fan Mounting Clearance
content: Three-part stack-up for fan blade tip clearance to heat sink fin array in ASM-007. Nominal clearance 4.0 mm, worst-case minimum 2.1 mm, which exceeds the 1.5 mm minimum required for airflow efficiency. Fan mounting slot tolerances revised to ±0.3 mm from ±0.5 mm to reduce variability.

title: DFM Note – Motor Drive Enclosure Cable Gland Entry
content: Punched cable entry holes in ASM-008 bottom panel should be relocated 15 mm inward to maintain minimum 20 mm edge distance for M20 gland locknuts. Current layout creates risk of panel deformation during gland tightening. Revised panel layout drawing issued as DWG-008-B.

title: RFQ – Sensor Module Housing Injection Moulding
content: RFQ for injection moulding of ASM-003 sensor housing body and cover in glass-filled nylon PA66-GF30. Cavity steel P20 with texture VDI 30 on exterior surfaces. Annual volume 2,000 units. Prototype tooling (single cavity) required in 10 weeks, production tooling (4-cavity) in 18 weeks. Include DFM review in quotation.
